notes: Aggregator pages (booking.com, agoda.com) are JS-rendered hollow shells when fetched server-side; review scores were sourced from Booking.com listings via search-result snippets and Tripadvisor.
Prices are indicative bands in INR per night for two adults inclusive of taxes; re-verify on the booking date.
Fibre flag = property advertises high-speed/fibre wifi or has third-party confirmation; speedtest at check-in is still required for the 6-night Pokhara block.
Pokhara fibre context: WorldLink + Vianet provide 50–150 Mbps SME plans; Lakeside cafes routinely hit 20–50 Mbps on fibre (Nomads.com / Pokhara Coworking).
Tiger Palace by Soaltee is in Tilottama / Bhairahawa (NOT Pokhara as the playbook spec lists). It is included as a Bhairahawa option.

candidates.name: Radisson Blu MBD Hotel, Noida
candidates.notes: Sector 18, valet+free parking (height limit — confirm Roxx fits), strong WPE access via Noida Expressway. 24h F&B, secure for SUV. Good evening-arrival check-in track record.

candidates.name: Crowne Plaza New Delhi Mayur Vihar Noida (IHG)
candidates.notes: Direct WPE/DND on-ramp at Mayur Vihar. Complimentary valet parking, IHG-grade security. Best for an early-morning 10 May restart toward Gorakhpur.

candidates.name: Radisson Blu Hotel Greater Noida
candidates.notes: Free parking + valet, full-service spa, breakfast praised. Slightly south — adds ~20 min to Yamuna Expressway entry vs Sector 18.

candidates.name: Ramada by Wyndham Gorakhpur Gorakhnath Mandir Road
candidates.notes: Free parking, buffet breakfast praised, 4-star reliability. Gorakhnath Mandir Rd is a clean run to bypass + Sunauli highway next morning.

candidates.name: Nirvana Sarovar Portico Gorakhpur
candidates.notes: Free parking, ~2 km from station. Strong breakfast + dinner spread. Sarovar is a known business-traveller chain — secure for SUV with overnight monitoring.

candidates.name: Hotel Pink Paradise, Gorakhpur
candidates.notes: Budget backup. Free private parking + wifi, AC rooms, halal/veg breakfast. 3-star — pick only if Ramada/Nirvana fall through.

candidates.name: Tiger Palace by Soaltee, Bhairahawa
candidates.notes: Soaltee-managed, 5-star integrated resort 5 km off Sunauli border road. 3 restaurants, ample SUV parking, casino if needed for late-night food. Best post-border-day decompression. Above the INR 5,500 ceiling — flag if budget-strict.

candidates.name: Buddha Maya Garden by KGH Group, Lumbini
candidates.notes: Inside Lumbini Sanskritik zone, walking distance to Mayadevi Temple gate. KGH Group (also runs Waterfront Pokhara). Free private parking, breakfast included, garden setting — ideal for evening Lumbini darshan.

candidates.name: Bhairahawa Garden Resort
candidates.notes: 4-star, outdoor pool, free private parking, 24h front desk. 19 km from Lumbini Museum but close to Bhairahawa town — useful for the 21 May return night when you only need quick board+sleep before Sunauli exit.

candidates.name: Waterfront Resort by KGH Group, Pokhara
candidates.notes: Phewa Lake northern-shore, 15 min walk to Lakeside core. Free parking, daily buffet breakfast at Aqua Bird, advertises high-speed internet + conference WiFi. Lake-facing rooms. Best fibre+work+lake combo for the 6-night base.

candidates.name: Temple Tree Resort & Spa, Pokhara
candidates.notes: Lakeside Pamebagar, 4-star resort, free parking, free wifi in all rooms + property. Dedicated work-friendly desks. Highest-rated long-stay option in the zone — confirm fibre speed on arrival via speedtest. Most consistent power-cut diesel-genset coverage.

candidates.name: Atithi Resort & Spa, Pokhara
candidates.notes: Lakeside core, free in-room WiFi, free parking. Best value of the three for a 6-night stay. Has been a digital-nomad favourite in 2024–2025 due to reliable WorldLink fibre. Backup if Waterfront/Temple Tree are full.

candidates.name: The Pavilions Himalayas, Pokhara (Lakeview/The Farm)
candidates.notes: Optional splurge for one night during leisure (e.g. 19 May). Eco-resort across the lake, accessed by boat — not work-friendly base because internet is unspecified. Listed for completeness; do not book the full 6-night block here.

candidates.name: Shrestha Hotel HotSpring, Beni-Singha Tatopani
candidates.notes: Maygdi Beni / Singha Tatopani area. In-room WiFi, hot-spring access, deluxe rooms with desks, soundproofing, laptop workspace. Best for the 14 May acclimatisation halt. Email shresthahotelhotspring@gmail.com or +977-9847624428 to confirm SUV parking.

candidates.name: Hotel Natural Spring Pvt. Ltd., Tatopani
candidates.notes: 4-min walk to hot springs, Kali Gandaki river views. Free breakfast, free wifi, free parking. Last reviewed March 2026 — operating. Smaller property; pre-call to hold an SUV bay.

candidates.name: Dhaulagiri Lodge & Restaurant, Tatopani
candidates.notes: Backup-only. 50 m from hot springs with private back-path. Mixed reviews on bathroom/wifi — pick only if upper two are full. Below 8.0 review threshold; included to satisfy the 3-candidate requirement.

candidates.name: Hotel Om's Home, Jomsom
candidates.notes: TOP PICK for 2-night Jomsom block. 5 min walk from airport. Verified electric blankets + in-room heaters in multiple recent reviews. Solar-heated showers, free parking, free wifi, 27 twin rooms with attached bathrooms. Ranked #1 of 4 Jomsom small hotels on Tripadvisor.

candidates.name: Jomsom Mountain Retreat (Jomsom Mountain Resort)
candidates.notes: Hillside setting above town, panoramic Nilgiri views. Heating provided in rooms, parking on premises. Backup A — confirm electric blanket on booking call (heater is room-level diesel). Slightly removed from town centre — driving advantage for Roxx.

candidates.name: Hotel Trekkers Inn, Jomsom
candidates.notes: Backup B. Reviews note 'room heaters provided if needed; blankets usually sufficient.' Cheaper, central, parking on street. Pre-confirm heater availability — May nights can hit 5°C and the blanket-only policy will not cut it for the wife.

candidates.name: Shinta Mani Mustang (luxury alt)
candidates.notes: Bensley-designed luxury hilltop resort above Jomsom. Flagged as a one-off splurge option only — likely outside trip budget. Heated rooms, fibre/satellite, but minimum 3-night package — does not match a 2-night halt.

candidates.name: Lemon Tree Hotel, Lucknow
candidates.notes: TOP PICK. Adjacent Transport Nagar Metro on Kanpur–Lucknow Hwy, 10 min from airport. Free parking, free valet, free high-speed wifi. Smoke-free. Best matches outer-ring-road convenience for next-day Bikaner restart.

candidates.name: Hyatt Regency Lucknow
candidates.notes: Free parking + valet (height-restricted — confirm Roxx clears). Spotless cleanliness, full-service spa, excellent F&B. Above the INR 5,000 spec ceiling — flag for budget; pick only if you want a recovery day after the 470 km Bhairahawa→Lucknow drive.

candidates.name: Clarks Avadh, Lucknow
candidates.notes: Heritage 5-star on Gomti riverbank, 2.5 mi from station. Free WiFi + free parking, breakfast surcharge. Reviews note dated decor — pick if you want central Hazratganj access not outer-ring-road. Backup B.

redFlags: Bhairahawa Tiger Palace exceeds the INR 5,500 spec ceiling (INR 6,500–9,000). Decision point: pay up for the 5-star post-border-day decompression OR drop to Buddha Maya Garden / Bhairahawa Garden Resort which both fit the budget.
Pokhara Temple Tree exceeds typical mid-range (INR 9,000–12,000). For 6 nights total the bill compounds — Atithi or Waterfront are better blended-budget choices for the workation block.
Hyatt Regency Lucknow exceeds the INR 5,000 ceiling. Lemon Tree is the in-budget primary.

Jomsom Trekkers Inn states 'heater provided if needed; blankets usually sufficient' — explicitly call/email to confirm a working in-room heater for both 15 and 16 May nights. Blanket-only is insufficient at ~5°C with co-traveller.
Beni/Tatopani Dhaulagiri Lodge has Booking score ~7.8 (below the 8.0 minimum) — included only to provide a third candidate. Prefer Shrestha Hotel HotSpring or Hotel Natural Spring.

Pokhara fibre claim is ambient/area-level (WorldLink + Vianet 50–150 Mbps SME plans available, Lakeside cafes verified at 20–50 Mbps). No single hotel was independently speedtest-verified at >=50 Mbps for May 2026 — RUN A SPEEDTEST AT CHECK-IN on day 1; if fails, demote to Atithi Resort or relocate to Pokhara Coworking Space day-passes.

Booking.com / Agoda / MMT direct page-fetches returned empty (JS-rendered). Compiled prices are derived from search snippets and aggregator-summary text. Re-verify exact INR before booking — aggregator price gaps >30% cannot be confirmed without live page access.

iOverlander / blog cross-check for Jomsom inventory was attempted; no post-2026-03-01 traveller posts surfaced new properties. Hotel Om's Home and Jomsom Mountain Retreat remain the consensus top picks.
